shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Change, turn off or restore the keys of the commands. A key needs Ctrl or Alt (F1 to F12 can stand alone). Press Escape while recording to cancel.

scopeHint.reader: Work only while the reader is focused; they may reuse a key of another place but not of the same place.

shortcuts.needsModifier: Use Ctrl or Alt with the key (only F1 to F12 can be used alone).
shortcuts.fixedKey: {{key}} is a fixed key and cannot be assigned.
shortcuts.conflictsTitle: Two commands cannot share a key. Fix this to save:
shortcuts.fixed: Fixed keys that cannot be changed: Esc, Enter, the arrow keys, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and Ctrl+X.
